newsitem.title: CHINA: China Chengbei oil output to hit 1.6 mln T in '96.
newsitem.headline: China Chengbei oil output to hit 1.6 mln T in '96.

text.p: China's Chengbei offshore oilfield in eastern Shandong province is expected to produce 1.6 million tonnes of oil in 1996, officials said on Monday.

Chengbei will produce an estimated 1.0 million tonnes from shallow water deposits in 1996, plus 600,000 tonnes from reserves further offshore, an official of the China National Offshore Oil Co said by telephone.
"That is not very large," the official said, adding China's total offshore oil output in 1995 was 8.4 million tonnes.
Output from Chengbei fell by about three percent in 1995 after maintaining output of 400,000 tonnes a year for six years, according to official figures.
Chengbei is part of the Shengli oilfield, China's second largest.
